[SWS_SM_00643] Shutdown of affected StateMachines during a call to Pre-
pareRollback method
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
Modelled Process
controlling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
, during a call
to
PrepareRollback
method, shall stop every affected
StateMachine
of type
Agent
.
⌋
Result of the preparation for rollback should be communicated back to
Update and
Configuration Management
.
